senses.gloss:
अणु, उस्, उस् or वी, उ, fine, minute, atomic; (उस्),
m. an atom of matter; an atom of time; the
54, 675, 000th part of a muhūrta (of 48 minutes);
N. of a grain, Panicum Miliaceum; N. of Śiva;
(उ), n. (in prosody) the fourth part of a mātrā.
—अणु-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, very fine or minute, gentle.
—अणु-तैल, अम्, n., N. of a medical oil.
—अणु-
त्व, अम्, n. or अणु-ता, f. minuteness, atomic nature.
—अणु-भा, f. lightning.
—अणु-मध्य-वीज, अम्,
n. title of a hymn.
—अणु-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, having
the size of an atom.
—अणु-मात्रिक, अस्, आ, अम्,
having the size of an atom; containing the atomic
elements (मात्रा) of the body.
—अणु-रेणु, उस्,
m. f. atomic dust (as seen in sun-beams).
—अणु-रेणु-
जाल, अम्, n. an aggregate of such atomic dust.
—अणु-रेवती f., N. of a plant, Croton Polyandrum.
—अणु-वेदान्त, अम्, n. title of a book.
—अणु-
व्रीहि, इस्, m., N. of a fine sort of rice.
—अणु-शस्,
ind. into or in minute particles.
—अणू-भू, cl. 1. P.
-भवति, -वितुम्, to become minute or atomic.
—अणू-भाव, अस्, m. the becoming an atom.
—अण्व्-
अन्त, अस्, m. a hair-splitting question.

अणुक, अस्, आ, अम्, fine, minute, atomic; acute,
clever, subtle.
अणुह अणुह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vibhrāja.
